significance: Inaugural T20 World Cup title; Dhoni's first ICC tournament as captain; ignited India's T20 revolution.
Historic ODI tri-series victory in Australia, cementing youthful Indian white-ball era.
India became the No. 1 ranked Test team for the first time in history under Dhoni's leadership.
First Asia Cup title for India in 15 years.
CSK completed double of IPL + CLT20 in same calendar year.
India's 2nd World Cup win after 28 years. Dhoni hit iconic winning six (91* off 79 balls, Player of the Match).
First team in IPL history to successfully defend their title.
Dhoni became the only captain in cricket history to win all three major ICC white-ball trophies (T20 WC, CWC, CT).
Second CLT20 title for CSK; Suresh Raina 109* & Dhoni 23*.
6th Asia Cup title for India; Dhoni finished match with 20* off 6 balls.
'The Comeback Kings' - CSK won IPL title upon returning to the league after a two-year suspension.
CSK's 4th IPL title in Dhoni's 300th match as T20 captain.
Record-equaling 5th IPL title for CSK; dramatic last-ball thriller at 3:00 AM.
